title: Page topologies
description: Page skeletons for direction building; each direction picks a different one.

items.name: split-hero
items.sketch_1440:
[ H1 + lead + CTA ][   image   ]
[ card ][ card ][ card ]
items.suits: almost anything; that is the problem.
items.fails: indistinguishable from every template. Allowed only as `safe`, and then executed better than the category.

items.name: full-bleed statement
items.sketch_1440:
[        H1 over full-width photo        ]
[ narrow text column ]
items.phone: crop the photo deliberately (art direction, not centre crop).
items.fails: stock photo, text contrast on busy image.

items.name: broadsheet front page
items.sketch_1440:
[ masthead / date line                    ]
[ lead story 2/3      ][ column of briefs ]
[ story ][ story ][ story ]  ruled columns
items.suits: clients with many news or offers, editorial voice.
items.phone: lead story, then briefs as a list.
items.fails: becomes a card grid with rules.

items.name: index / table of contents
items.suits: clear catalogue of services, consultancies, archives.
items.fails: no hierarchy if every line weighs the same; give one line a reason.

items.name: timetable / sequence
items.sketch_1440:
[ 08:00 | Stop name | what happens ]
[ 09:30 | Stop name | what happens ]
items.fails: fake times; use real steps.

items.name: annotated document
items.sketch_1440:
[ document image / page  ][ margin notes ]
   ① ② ③ markers on the document
items.phone: document full width, notes below with numbers.
items.fails: unreadable crop; notes as decoration.

items.name: single column essay
items.sketch_1440:
[ 60-70ch column, H1 as first line ]
      [ pull quote ] [ inline figure ]
items.fails: wall of text without entry points.

items.name: ledger / table-first
items.sketch_1440:
[ column heads: item | for whom | result | time ]
[ row ]
[ row ]
items.suits: price lists (where allowed), comparisons, technical products.
items.fails: tables that scroll sideways.

items.name: catalogue grid with specimen
items.sketch_1440:
[ specimen large ][ meta list ]
[ tile ][ tile ][ tile ][ tile ]
items.fails: equal tiles, no specimen.

items.name: asymmetric poster
items.sketch_1440:
[ HUGE word ]
              [ small text block ]
       [ image offset into margin ]
items.suits: brand surfaces with few words, culture, events.
items.phone: poster scales down, small text stays legible.
items.fails: H1 overflow, no information.

items.name: question-led / FAQ as structure
items.sketch_1440:
[ The question your audience asks (H1) ]
[ answer ][ answer ][ answer ]  as Q → A blocks
items.suits: advisers, health, legal, B2B with fears.
items.fails: generic questions.

items.name: map / place-led
items.sketch_1440:
[ map or floor plan with numbered points ]
[ 1 place  2 place  3 place ]
items.fails: map tiles from US SaaS without consent; use a static drawn map.

items.name: pegboard / tool wall
items.sketch_1440: [ outlined tools on a grid, each labelled ]
items.suits: trades, agencies with clear tools, software features.
items.fails: icon grid in disguise.

items.name: conversation / transcript
items.sketch_1440:
Kunde:  question
Till:   answer
Kunde:  objection
items.fails: invented quotes; use real or clearly labelled sample dialogue.

items.name: split screen two worlds
items.sketch_1440: [ before / problem ][ after / solution ]  scroll in sync
items.fails: cliché before/after slider.

items.name: dossier / stacked sheets
items.sketch_1440:
[ sheet 1: cover ]
  [ sheet 2: finding ]
    [ sheet 3: plan ]   offset, layered
items.fails: skeuomorphic kitsch.

items.name: numbers-first board
items.sketch_1440:
[ 1 big real figure ][ what it means ]
[ figure ][ figure ][ figure ]
items.suits: clients with real, sourced numbers only.
items.fails: invented statistics. Never with placeholder numbers.

items.name: gallery wall / exhibition
items.sketch_1440:
[ work ]   [ work ]
     [ wall text ]
[ work ]        [ work ]
items.phone: one work at a time with wall text.
items.fails: masonry grid.

items.name: letter
items.sketch_1440:
[ place, date ]
[ Salutation, ]
[ letter body in the client's voice ]
[ signature ]
items.fails: too long; keep a P.S. as the CTA.

items.name: programme / bill
items.sketch_1440:
[ TONIGHT / THIS SEASON ]
[ act  ·  time  ·  place ]
[ act  ·  time  ·  place ]
items.fails: theatre costume for a non-event business.
